newsitem.title: UK: Victrex rises after positive press report.
newsitem.headline: Victrex rises after positive press report.

text.p: Shares in chemicals group Victrex Plc climbed on Thursday, recovering from Wednesday's near 12-month low, after positive press comment on the stock, dealers said.
Victrex shares rose 11p to 171p by 0843 GMT on volume of 150,000 shares.
A report in the Financial Times newspaper said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson argued the stock deserved a higher rating following the company's half year results on Wednesday, delaers said.
Victrex's interim pre-tax profits fell to 5.1 million stg in the six months to March 31, 1997 from 6.3 million for the same period last year. Turnover rose to 19.5 million stg from 19.4 million stg.
"I think the price movement in the shares today reflects the true story, which is of the company's good volume growth," said Michael Eastwood, analyst at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson.
Eastwood said he had set a medium-term target of 240p for the shares.
